title: 第15章 御剑术第16章 灵桃熟了
content_zh:
桃花山刘家修仙传最新章节_第15章 御剑术第1页_桃花山刘家修仙传飞云剑仙_热点小说网
> 第15章 御剑术（第1页）
次日清晨，刘长旭修炼完了培元练气决。走到院中，来到云雾茶树前。
这棵茶树已经没有了移栽时的、枯黄萎靡，开始恢复了它的神采，枝叶在朝露的滋润下翠绿欲滴，移栽的很成功。
再看向两棵碧玉灵桃树上挂着的72个碧玉桃，已有半个拳头大小，虽然还很青涩，但也有一分灵桃的清香。
想到还有两个多月就能吃到自己种植收获的灵桃，刘长旭心情又好了几分。
只是想到家族在每年在灵桃、灵米成熟时，都会遭受大批妖兽袭击抢夺的情况后，心情又坏了几分，看来还是要增强自己的实力呀！
由于家族法阵不能挡住灵果、灵米成熟后溢出的香味，每年都在灵果、灵米成熟的季节，都会吸引大批妖兽前来抢夺，在与妖兽的战斗中，经常造成族人死伤。除了妖兽，还会有邪修的光临。炼气修仙家族生存之难可想而知。
在给灵桃树和灵茶树，浇灌了灵泉水之后，刘长旭就去膳堂和家人吃了早饭。
在吃早饭时，由于饭量大增，刘长旭的吃相，再也不复过去的文雅，有些饥不择食，让在场众人捂嘴偷笑，灵儿则天真的问到：“哥哥，你今天怎么吃这么多呀！”
听到这句话，刘长旭满脸通红，尴尬无比。最后，还是父亲替刘长旭回答了这个问题，说道：“你哥哥是因为修炼炼体功法，饭量才大的。”
“那哥哥会变胖吗？”小丫头好奇的问到。
早饭后，刘长旭赶紧回到自己的小院，免得弟弟妹妹们问东问西的。
回到小院后，刘长旭来到练功房，又开始了上午的法术修炼，刘长旭先练习的是火球术、水箭术、木盾术、缠绕术。
经过一个时辰的修炼，法术的质量有了一丝进步。特别是木盾术和缠绕术提高较快。修炼法术对修为的进步也会有不错的效果。
接下来，刘长旭又开始了学习修炼御剑术和风雨剑法。
御剑术是一部在御物术基础上改进而来的，它以修仙者神识为指引，法力催动飞剑进行攻击的法术，并无品阶，是随着修仙者修为提升而威力提高的术法。
飞剑攻击的距离和攻击力和修仙者的神识远近基本上是成正比，当御剑术修炼到高深处，可以做到千里之外取人首级。
而要御使飞剑上天飞行，则是需要到炼气后期的法力和神识才可以做到。
掐诀施法后，龙泉剑一声轻鸣飞向空中，并在神识指引下飞向靶石，但由于掐动法诀时的一丝失误，龙泉剑就掉在地上。

再次将龙泉剑摄到空中，在飞了几尺距离后又掉落，反复御剑飞了五次后。神识已然消耗一空。
在打坐恢复神识和法力时，刘长旭又抓紧拿出风雨剑法开始研读。
这部剑法是法术与剑术的结合，以剑御法，以法带剑，威力相当不错，是一部黄阶上品剑术。
这部剑术是通过御使法剑催动风、水两种属性灵气攻击的剑术。这部剑法能使法剑的攻击速度和攻击面大大提高，威力相当不错。
当刘长旭舞动龙泉剑时，空中发出阵阵风雨之声，狂暴的剑气引动风雨之力攻击靶石后，青冈石应声而碎，飞溅的雨滴也有一些打在周围的石壁上，将石壁打的坑坑洼洼。
刘长旭感叹这个练功房看来坚持不了太久。

The latest chapter of The Legend of the Liu Family in Peach Blossom Mountain_Chapter 15 Sword Control Page 1_The Legend of the Immortal Cultivation of the Liu Family in Peach Blossom Mountain Feiyun Sword Immortal_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 15 Sword Control (Page 1)
Early the next morning, Liu Changxu finished practicing the Peiyuan Qi Training Art. Walk to the courtyard and come to the Yunwu tea tree.
This tea tree is no longer yellow and wilted as it was when it was transplanted, and has begun to regain its splendor. The branches and leaves are green under the moisture of the morning dew. The transplant was very successful.
Then look at the 72 jasper peaches hanging on the two jasper peach trees. They are half the size of a fist. Although they are still very green, they still have the fragrance of peaches.
Liu Changxu felt a little better when he thought that he would be able to eat the spiritual peaches he planted and harvested in more than two months.
Just thinking about how the family would be attacked and robbed by a large number of monsters every year when the spiritual peaches and spiritual rice matured, made me feel a little worse. It seems that I still need to strengthen my strength!
Since the family magic circle cannot block the fragrance that overflows when the spiritual fruits and spiritual rice mature, every year during the season when the spiritual fruits and spiritual rice mature, a large number of monsters are attracted to snatch them. In the battles with the monsters, clan members are often killed or injured. In addition to monsters, there will also be evil cultivators coming. One can imagine how difficult it is for a family that cultivates qi and cultivates immortality to survive.
After watering the spiritual peach trees and spiritual tea trees with spiritual spring water, Liu Changxu went to the dining hall to have breakfast with his family.
During breakfast, due to the increase in appetite, Liu Changxu's eating appearance was no longer as elegant as before, and he was a little hungry. Everyone present covered their mouths and snickered. Ling'er asked innocently: "Brother, why did you eat so much today!"
Hearing these words, Liu Changxu's face turned red and he was extremely embarrassed. In the end, it was his father who answered the question for Liu Changxu and said, "Your brother eats a lot because he practices physical training."
"Will my brother get fat?" the little girl asked curiously.
After breakfast, Liu Changxu hurried back to his small courtyard to prevent his younger brothers and sisters from asking questions.
After returning to the small courtyard, Liu Changxu came to the practice room and started the morning spell practice again. Liu Changxu first practiced fireball, water arrow, wooden shield, and entanglement.
After an hour of practice, the quality of the spell has improved slightly. In particular, the wooden shield technique and the entanglement technique improve quickly. Practicing spells will also have a good effect on the improvement of cultivation.
Next, Liu Changxu began to learn and practice sword control and wind and rain sword techniques.
The Sword Control Technique is an improvement on the Object Control Technique. It is guided by the spiritual consciousness of the immortal cultivator, and the mana urges the flying sword to attack. There is no grade. It is a technique that increases in power as the immortal cultivator improves his cultivation level.
The distance and attack power of the flying sword attack are basically proportional to the spiritual distance of the cultivator. When the sword control skills are practiced to a high level, one can kill people's heads from thousands of miles away.
To control the flying sword to fly into the sky, you need to have mana and spiritual consciousness in the later stage of Qi refining.
After the spell was cast, the Longquan Sword flew into the air with a soft cry, and flew towards the target stone under the guidance of his spiritual consciousness. However, due to a slight mistake when pinching the spell, the Longquan Sword fell to the ground.
He took the Longquan Sword into the air again, flew a few feet away and then dropped it. He repeatedly flew the sword five times. His spiritual consciousness has been exhausted.
While meditating to restore his consciousness and magic power, Liu Changxu quickly took out the Wind and Rain Sword Technique and began to study it.
This swordsmanship is a combination of magic and swordsmanship. The sword is used to control the law and the law is used to carry the sword. The power is quite good. It is a yellow-level high-grade swordsmanship.
This swordsmanship is a swordsmanship that utilizes the aura of wind and water attributes to attack. This sword technique can greatly increase the attack speed and attack surface of the magic sword, and its power is quite good.
When Liu Changxu danced the Longquan Sword, there were sounds of wind and rain in the air. The violent sword energy caused the power of wind and rain to attack the target stone. The green stone shattered in response, and some of the splashing raindrops also hit the surrounding stone walls, making the stone walls pitted..
Liu Changxu lamented that this practice studio seemed unable to last long.
